description: Retrieve recent LLM call records captured by Argosvix. Filterable by provider / model / time range / tag (tagKey + tagValue pair). Defaults to the last 24 hours, 100 records.

beforeId.description: Keyset pagination cursor (id of the last row on the previous page). Must be used together with beforeTimestamp

beforeTimestamp.description: Keyset pagination cursor (timestamp of the last row on the previous page, ISO-8601). Must be used together with beforeId. Descending timestamp order only

latencyMax.description: Upper bound on response latency (ms, >= 0). Combine with latencyMin for a range

latencyMin.description: Lower bound on response latency (ms, >= 0). For outlier drill-down (e.g. "only calls over 2 seconds")

limit.description: Number of records to return (1-500, default 100)

model.description: Model name to filter by (substring match). Omit for all models

provider.description: Provider to filter by (openai / anthropic / gemini / mistral / xai / moonshot / deepseek / alibaba / meta). Omit for all providers

tagKey.description: Tag key to filter by (alphanumeric + _ - only, 1-64 chars, must not start or end with -). Must be used together with tagValue (either one alone returns 400)

tagValue.description: Tag value to filter by (exact match, 1-256 chars). Must be used together with tagKey

name: query_calls
